title: Law to raise income limits for senior and disabled homeowner tax breaks
summary: This bill would raise the maximum household income allowed for the Senior Citizen Homeowners' Exemption (SCHE) and the Disabled Homeowners' Exemption (DHE) from $50,000 to $75,000, starting July 1, 2027. It also updates the sliding-scale exemption schedules to match the new threshold and incorporates a planned increase in the top SCHE exemption from 50 percent to 65 percent. Under the new schedule, homeowners earning under $72,000 could get a 65 percent exemption, phasing down to 5 percent for those earning up to $83,400.
